label: HMC5883L 3-Axis Magnetometer
info: Electronic compass demo: reads magnetic field from HMC5883L every 200 ms, computes heading from X/Y axes using atan2(y, x), and displays as a gauge (0–360°). A debug node shows raw X/Y/Z values in µT. Vertical mount detection: if |Z| > 30 µT, a warning appears indicating tilt compensation is needed. The HMC5883L has a fixed I²C address of 0x1E. Configure averaging=8, ODR=15 Hz, gain=±1.3 Ga for Earth field measurements.

name: heading & tilt check
